programme.title: Last Survivors
programme.desc: Un père et son fils, rencontrent un étranger qui menace de détruire l'utopie qu'ils ont construite.

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.6
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.5
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.8
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: A l'ombre des regards
programme.desc: Une jeune femme disparue doit retrouver son chemin avec l'aide du seul homme qui peut la voir.

programme.title: Last Survivors
programme.desc: Un père et son fils, rencontrent un étranger qui menace de détruire l'utopie qu'ils ont construite.

programme.title: Ainsi va la vie
programme.desc: Oren Little, agent immobilier bourru et égoïste, voit sa vie chamboulée lorsque son fils lui confie sa fille de 9 ans dont il ne soupçonnait pas l'existence. Oren tente alors de s'en débarrasser en l'imposant à sa voisine. Mais les choses ne sont pas toujours aussi simples.

programme.title: Life or Something Like It
programme.desc: Lanie est une journaliste télé ambitieuse, convaincue qu'avoir la plus parfaite des coiffures, le plus beau des amants et le plus luxueux des appartements est ce qui rend véritablement heureux...

programme.title: Misfits club
programme.desc: Valeria vient juste de déménager à Madrid après la séparation de ses parents. Nouvelles amitiés, une ville aux multiples opportunités, premier amour… Des expériences fortes qui changera à jamais la vie de Valeria et de son groupe d'amis.

programme.title: Célibataire cherche l'amour
programme.desc: Lucy Neal, une violoniste, se remet en question après que son ex petit ami ait décidé de rompre, la jugeant trop frigide. Afin de lui prouver le contraire, elle se lance dans la création d'une liste de choses “sexy” à réaliser.

programme.title: La retraite de l'amour
programme.desc: Lorsque la marque de beauté Bloom décide de se concentrer sur les ventes en ligne, Jenny doit trouver comment vivre dans l'équilibre travail-vie personnelle , tandis que Nate a déjà trouvé la solution. Lorsque des étincelles jaillissent entre eux, un seul problème se pose : c'est le frère de son patron...

programme.title: Hollywood Sunrise
programme.desc: Les acteurs d'Hollywood dissèquent leur vie personnelle lorsque tout semble s'entrechoquer.

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: The story of a long-lost book that mysteriously reappears and connects an old man searching for his son with a girl seeking a cure for her mother's loneliness.

programme.title: Horatio, un Ami Extraordinaire
programme.desc: Depuis que son père est mort, 16 ans, Juliette, sa belle-mère et ses deux demi-frères luttent pour garder leur ranch. Mais Juliette pense qu'elle a un secret qui pourrait garder le ranch ouvert: son cheval, Horatio, peut parler!

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: The New Captain Scarlet - Épisode 17: Situé en 2068, Captain Scarlet suit la "guerre psychologique" entre la Terre et les Mysterons, une race martienne qui possède un contrôle partiel sur la matière. Lorsqu'un malentendu pousse des astronautes humains à attaquer leur ville sur Mars, les Mysterons jurent de se venger et lancent une série de représailles contre la Terre.

programme.title: Let it Snow
programme.desc: Lors d'une fabuleuse journée enneigée, James rencontre Sarah. Dès le moment où ils partagent leur première après-midi dans la neige, ils sont liés pour la vie. Mais quatre ans plus tard, ils se retrouvent tous deux à New York, menant des vies très différentes. Par crainte que Sarah n'en épouse un autre, James prie pour qu'il neige, et pour une seconde chance avec son premier amour.

programme.title: Wedding Bell Blues
programme.desc: Trois femmes sont colocataires : une est sur le point de se marier, une autre découvre qu'elle est enceinte de son petit ami de longue date et une troisième a une file interminable d'hommes dans et hors de sa chambre. Un abandon soudain les mène à Vegas.

programme.title: Yes, God, Yes
programme.desc: Au début des années 2000, une adolescente catholique et bien rangée découvre la tentation sur un chat aol.

programme.title: 30 Ans Sinon Rien
programme.desc: Jenna, adolescente de treize ans qui rêve de devenir célèbre, s'enferme dans un placard après avoir subi une expérience humiliante. Lorsqu'elle se décide enfin de sortir de sa cachette, elle s'aperçoit que, par un phénomène extraordinaire et inexplicable, elle est sur le point de célébrer son trentième anniversaire et qu'elle est devenue extrêmement belle et populaire.Alors que Jenna commence à profiter de sa toute nouvelle vie, elle découvre que celui auquel elle tenait tant n'est plus là. Non seulement elle n'a plus aucune nouvelle de Matt, mais elle apprend qu'il s'apprête à épouser une autre demoiselle...

programme.title: The Edge Of Seventeen
programme.desc: Nadine et Krista découvrent le monde merveilleux du lycée. Mais leur belle amitié est mise à mal lorsque la première apprend que la seconde sort avec son grand frère...

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.desc: Nick rêve d'un rendez-vous avec Suzanne, mais elle ne souhaite que son amitié. Lorsqu'elle se trouve coincée à cause de son travail, il lui propose de lui amener ses enfants à Vancouver pour le réveillon. Mais pour eux, aucun homme n'est assez bien pour leur mère, et ils sont capables de tout.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: Dans la petite ville touristique de Nelson, Washington, le sympathique chef des pompiers , C.D. Bales (Steve Martin) est sensible aux remarques sur son nez particulièrement long. Une belle astronome intelligente, Roxanne (Daryl Hannah), en ville pour étudier une comète, est attirée par un autre nouveau-venu, le pompier professionnel travaillant auprès de C.D., Chris (Rick Rossovich).

programme.title: Blue Mountain State: The Rise of Thadland
programme.desc: Thad ayant eu son diplôme et ayant été recruté à la NFL, c'est maintenant à Alex, le quarterback, de diriger son équipe mais aussi de se battre pour empêcher que le doyen vindicatif ne ferme définitivement sa maison.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Un petit confiseur est furieux de découvrir qu'une grande entreprise de confiserie s'installe dans les environs. Mais tout se complique lorsqu'une romance improbable naît avec sa nouvelle concurrente.

programme.title: Oncle Drew
programme.desc: Un jeune propriétaire d'équipe et l'Oncle Drew (la star de la NBA Kyrie Irving) rassemblent l'ancienne équipe de basket de Drew pour prouver qu'un groupe de septuagénaires peut encore gagner.

programme.title: Hot School 2
programme.desc: Les adolescents sans cervelle de Brain Drain sont de retour et cette fois-ci, ils iront à la faculté de médecine vétérinaire de l'université de Harvard.

programme.title: Custer, l'homme de l'Ouest
programme.desc: L'amour de George Armstrong Custer pour les traditions héroïques du calvaire et son dégoût pour l'arrivée de l'industrialisation le conduisent à son destin à Little Big Horn.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: Un officier de cavalerie sympathisant des Sioux organise une rencontre entre Sitting Bull et le président Grant, mais un agent indien met à l'épreuve la patience des Sioux.

programme.title: Une minute pour prier, une seconde pour mourir
programme.desc: L'apparition de Clay McCord déclenche une violente confrontation entre le marshal local, McCord et d'autres hors-la-loi.

programme.title: Le Retour de Sabata
programme.desc: Les citoyens de Hobsonville engagent Sabata pour les débarrasser du clan McIntock, qui les taxe de force et illégalement sous le prétexte du développement de la ville.

programme.title: Le désert rouge
programme.desc: Deux hommes trouvent un bébé abandonné et se disputent la propriété de l'enfant, ce qui entraîne une rivalité qui durera toute la vie.

programme.title: 4 balles pour Joë
programme.desc: La mort mystérieuse d'un homme qui s'apprête à quitter une petite ville du Kansas avec sa petite amie déclenche une série d'événements malheureux.

programme.title: Route mystérieuse
programme.desc: Un détective aborigène retourne dans l'Outback australien pour enquêter sur le meurtre d'une jeune fille.

programme.title: Au-delà de la haine
programme.desc: Une famille de pionniers est presque entièrement détruite par des Indiens en quête de vengeance : Le petit George est laissé évanoui sur le sol, et sa petite sœur adoptée par le chef indien. Le destin les réunira à nouveau.

programme.title: Les cavaliers du destin
programme.desc: Le méchant Kincaid contrôle l'approvisionnement local en eau et prévoit de se débarrasser des autres éleveurs. L'agent gouvernemental Saunders se présente sous couverture pour se débarrasser de Kincaid et gagner le cœur d'une de ses victimes, Fay Denton.

programme.title: Le retour de Billy the Kid
programme.desc: Billy the Kid tente de vivre en paix, sous un nouveau nom et dans une ville frontalière, mais il est approché par un prédicateur qui lui demande de l'aider à libérer la ville d'un homme impitoyable et de son tireur.

programme.title: Les amours de Salomé
programme.desc: Une célèbre ballerine viennoise fuit l'Europe pendant la guerre austro-prussienne et tombe amoureuse d'un bandit américain qui ressemble à son défunt amant royal.

programme.title: Heartstopper
programme.desc: Dans un hôpital de banlieue presque désert, une nuit de tempête devient un cauchemar absolu lorsque Jonathan Chambers, un tueur en série exécuté quelques heures plus tôt, se réveille sur la table d'autopsie. Son cœur, pourtant arrêté, se remet à battre… un battement sec, violent, monstrueux, qui fait vibrer son thorax déchiré. Arrachant ses sutures, ses côtes ouvertes comme les dents d'un piège, Chambers se relève dans un bain de sang. Chaque pas laisse une trace rouge sombre sur le sol. Son corps brisé ne cherche pas à guérir : il saigne, claque, grince, comme porté par quelque chose de plus sombre que la vie.

programme.title: Final Draft
programme.desc: Un scénariste en herbe qui tente d'écrire un nouveau scénario d'horreur sombre mentalement après plusieurs jours d'isolement dans son appartement.

programme.title: Cercle Infernal
programme.desc: La vie de deux sœurs change radicalement, depuis qu'elles ont été hypnotisées par un disque vinyle mystique des années 1970.

programme.title: Seisme Imminent
programme.desc: Un pirate informatique mécontent utilise le fils rebelle du président d'une grande société de logiciels pour créer Havoc.

programme.title: eXistenZ
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, Allegra Geller crée eXistenZ, un jeu connecté au système nerveux. Après une tentative d'assassinat, elle fuit avec Ted, un stagiaire. Ensemble, ils plongent dans une course folle, entre réalité et monde virtuel.

programme.title: Les dieux des profondeurs
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une mission audacieuse conduit une équipe de sous-marin en eaux profondes dans une mystérieuse ouverture au fond de l'océan, ils découvrent un monde sous-marin perdu et réveillent son ancienne race d'êtres d'un autre monde...

programme.title: Ultimate Chabite
programme.desc: Kevin, Antho, Erwan et Rodrigo lancent un chabite, qui ne va jamais s'arrêter. Au départ c'est un simple jeu viral et absurde, mais très vite les complications arrivent. Les accidents se multiplient et les autorités commencent à s'y intéresser, tandis qu'Antho, le plus radical des 4 amis...

programme.title: Alien Invasion : L'Éveil du Phénix
programme.desc: Une pluie d'astéroïdes frappe une station spatiale, puis atterrit dans une zone reculée du Grand Canyon. Des capsules mystérieuses se forment et mutent rapidement en créatures menaçant la station spatiale et la Terre.

programme.title: Last survivors
programme.desc: Au lendemain d'un événement apocalyptique qui a contraint les gens à un isolement extrême. Un père et son fils rencontrent une étrangère qui menace de détruire l'utopie qu'ils ont construite.

programme.title: Diamante
programme.desc: Marta est chargée de livrer un grand nombre de diamants à Dubaï. Elle s'apprête à passer la nuit avec son bien-aimé lorsqu'un homme cagoulé fait irruption dans la maison.

programme.title: Charlie Says
programme.desc: La tragique histoire d'une jeune fille américaine transformée en tueuse sans pitié durant l'été 1969 influencée par Charles Manson.

programme.title: Lidice
programme.desc: Le 27 mai 1942 à Prague, un officier SS est victime d'un attentat organisé par la Résistance. Le 9 juin, les SS encerclent le village de Lidice, soupçonné d'avoir abrité les membres du commando.

programme.title: Criminel
programme.desc: En rentrant d'une soirée arrosée avec ses collègues, un officier de police renverse un jeune cycliste. Alors qu'il tente de réanimer l'enfant, il ment aux policiers venus prendre sa déposition...

programme.title: La bataille d'Amanda
programme.desc: Une ingénieure de génie accuse un collègue d'avoir volé et breveté son invention aéronautique. Alors qu'elle envisage un procès, l'homme est assassiné, faisant d'elle la principale suspecte de l'affaire.

programme.title: Evil Boy
programme.desc: Igor est prêt à tout pour le bonheur de Polina et, pour compenser la perte de son fils, le couple décide d'adopter. Mais au lieu d'un garçon ordinaire du refuge, leur famille accueille un enfant plus que difficile.

programme.title: La Prophétie des ombres
programme.desc: Un reporter est attiré dans une petite ville de Virginie pour enquêter sur une série d'événements étranges, notamment des visions psychiques et l'apparence d'entités mystérieuses.

programme.title: Mafia Inc
programme.desc: Les Gamache, couturiers de père en fils, habillent la famille mafieuse Paternò. Vince travaille au nom de Frank, le parrain, avec son fils aîné Giaco. Vince cherche à faire ses preuves et impressionner le parrain.

programme.title: Faux Semblants
programme.desc: Deux vrais jumeaux, gynécologues de renom, partagent vraiment tout dans leur vie. Un jour, une actrice vient les consulter et les deux frères en tombent amoureux...

programme.title: Le Masque du Démon
programme.desc: Au 17ème siècle, la sorcière Asa et son amant Igor, accusés de vampirisme, sont mis au supplice mais promettent une vengeance éternelle à leurs tortionnaires. Deux siècles plus tard, la malédiction se réalise : les vampires reviennent à la vie et recommencent à semer la terreur et la mort...

programme.title: Malum
programme.desc: Une jeune policière tente de percer le lien mystérieux entre la mort de son père et l'arrestation d'une secte. Pour ce faire, elle accepte de prendre poste dans le commissariat où son père a trouvé la mort. Bientôt, elle est victime d'événements surnaturels terrifiants...

programme.title: Vigilante
programme.desc: Fou de rage après l'agression de son épouse et le meurtre de son fils et écœuré par le laxisme et la corruption des autorités, qui ont permis aux responsables d'être libérés, un électricien new-yorkais s'acoquine avec un groupe d'auto-défense, dans lequel il refusait d'entrer jusqu'alors, afin de venger sa famille.

programme.title: The Belgian Wave
programme.desc: Au début des années 90, le journaliste Marc Varenberg et son caméraman disparaissent dans des circonstances mystérieuses alors qu'ils enquêtent sur la Vague Belge (une série d'observations d'Ovni survenus entre 1989 et 1991). Près de 30 ans plus tard, deux webreporters rouvrent l'enquête pour découvrir ce qui s'est réellement passé.

programme.title: Les Révoltés
programme.desc: Dans une Amérique tyrannisée par des miliciens, des amis cherchent à fuir au Canada.

programme.title: La Guerre des Mafias
programme.desc: Un ex-détenu est libéré prématurément de prison et se voit contraint d'intégrer une unité d'infiltration composée de six hommes.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: Un fermier et son fils accueillent un homme mystérieux, blessé, avec une sacoche remplie d'argent.

programme.title: Haunted : L'enfant du Passé
programme.desc: Après la mort de son père, Catherine retourne dans son ancien domaine familial en Norvège.

programme.title: The Resistance Fighter
programme.desc: À la fin de la Seconde Guerre mondiale, un courageux héros de guerre devient un agent du gouvernement polonais chargé d'obtenir l'aide de l'Angleterre contre l'Allemagne.

programme.title: La ligne de feu
programme.desc: L'histoire de la résistance héroïque des cadets de Podolsk aux abords de Moscou en octobre 1941.

programme.title: South Wind
programme.desc: Peter est un jeune délinquant de Belgrade plein d'ambition, spécialisé dans le vol de voitures. Mais le jour où il se trompe de véhicule, il se met à dos le chef des narcotrafiquants de la ville.

programme.title: Terminator Renaissance
programme.desc: En 2018, après l'apocalypse qui a vu s'affronter les hommes et les robots, John Connor est devenu le chef de la résistance humaine contre Skynet et son armée de Terminators. Sa vision du monde est pourtant remise en cause par l'apparition de Marcus Wright, un inconnu qui se souvient seulement de s'être trouvé dans le quartier des condamnés à mort. Connor doit découvrir si Marcus a été envoyé du futur ou s'il est un rescapé du passé. Alors que Skynet prépare l'assaut final, Connor et Marcus s'engagent dans une odyssée qui va les mener au cœur même des opérations de Skynet. Ils y perceront le terrible secret qui se cache derrière l'annihilation programmée de l'humanité tout entière...

programme.title: L'Evade Du Futur
programme.desc: Ils ont été créés dans le but de servir l'homme. Mais maintenant, guidés par une force sinistre, ils assassinent leurs serviteurs dans ce film d'aventure futuriste au rythme haletant. Tom Selleck joue le rôle de Jack Ramsay, un sergent du groupe Runaway, une force de sécurité chargée de l'élimination de robots défectueux ou 'déviants'.

programme.title: Escape Game
programme.desc: Dans ESCAPE GAME, le nouveau film d'Adam Robitel (INSIDIOUS : LA DERNIERE CLE), six personnes n'ayant rien en commun se retrouvent enfermées dans un jeu et devront trouver les indices ou mourir.

programme.title: Hanna
programme.desc: Hanna (SAOIARSE RONAN) a 16 ans. Elle est intelligente, curieuse, jolie - et se révèle être un assassin professionnel. Ayant passé presque toute sa vie dans la toundra à apprendre des techniques de combat enseignées par son père (ERIC BANA), elle revient à la civilisation où un agent sans scrupules de la CIA (CATE BLANCHETT) tente de la faire disparaître. Tout en apprenant comment elle est devenue une machine à tuer, Hanna doit se battre pour survivre et finalement, éliminer la personne qui est responsable de ce qu'elle est devenue.

programme.title: Ennemis rapprochés
programme.desc: Après un affrontement avec la police britannique, Frankie McGuire, membre de l'IRA, doit quitter l'Irlande pour les États-Unis. Il se cache dans une famille d'origine irlandaise, les O'Meary, dont le père, gagne sa vie en tant que policier.

programme.title: The Old Way
programme.desc: Colton Briggs, un ancien bandit armé, tient désormais une épicerie et vit tranquillement avec sa famille.

programme.title: Essential Killing
programme.desc: Capturé par les forces américaines, un Afghan est envoyé dans un centre de détention tenu secret. Lors d'un transfert, il s'échappe et se voit traqué sans relâche par une armée sans existence officielle dans une forêt inconnue. Il devra tout faire pour assurer sa survie.

programme.title: Déchaînés
programme.desc: Alors que les célèbres criminels Gary Tison et Randy Greenwalt s'évadent de prison, leur cavale se transforme rapidement en une sanglante chasse à l'homme.

programme.title: La Traque du Condor
programme.desc: Une décennie après la chute de l'Allemagne nazie, un aviateur américain voyage à travers l'Amérique du Sud à la recherche de criminels de guerre.

programme.title: Killing Salazar
programme.desc: Une équipe d'élite d'agents est chargée de protéger un dangereux baron de la drogue. Ils se réfugient dans un hôtel de luxe en attendant leur extraction. Ils se retrouvent bientôt au centre d'une embuscade alors que les anciens associés du baron de la drogue lancent un assaut explosif sur l'hôtel.

programme.title: Ultimate Justice
programme.desc: Une bande d'anciens soldats d'élite se reforme quand la famille de l'un d'entre eux est la cible d'une attaque.

programme.title: Mad Heidi
programme.desc: Dans une Suisse au régime totalitaire et imaginaire, tombée sous la coupe d'un magnat du fromage, Heidi vit dans les montagnes avec son grand-père qui fait de son mieux pour la protéger du monde extérieur.

programme.desc: En 1979, le tueur à gages Donald Lavoie, travaillant pour le boss de la pègre Claude Dubois, est compromis dans un meurtre par une recrue impulsive. Bien qu'il échappe à la justice, il est pris en chasse par le détective Roger Burns.

programme.title: New Life
programme.desc: It's a water world and life couldn't survive without it. And thanks to it, a mind blowing diversity of creatures thrive beneath the surface. Born to enjoy the riches underwater they must master their body's adaptations, learn to find food, to escape danger and above all become expert swimmers! Whether it's in rivers, on beaches or in the deep ocean, all must overcome the obstacles and fulfil their destiny, all are born to swim! Of all the habitats on earth, the ocean is perhaps the most challenging. Here salt, temperatures, currents and predators can make life difficult it's not an obvious place to want to bring up your babies… But even in these waters generation after generation beats the odds. They have overcome the challenges and become some of the most beautiful and graceful of creatures. But any baby born to swim has a lot to learn… All over the world there are creatures born to swim, and though humans are not, we seem determined to join them. Perhaps we are envious of their grace. Maybe we are all water babies at heart

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children. (S1 E01)

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: Pavel Hubeny, whose life would be unthinkable without the forest, is the head of the Šumava National Park. He is committed to ensuring that a primeval forest can grow for future generations, in which man does not interfere. This vision of a primeval forest is also shared by the forester Claus Bässler, who wants to counteract the extinction of species by having trees felled to create artificial deadwood and thus a new habitat for rare beetles and fungi. On the Vltava River lies the small town of Krumlov, the "Pearl of the Bohemian Forest" with its Baroque theater and fully preserved stage technology from the 17th century. Here the director Zuzana Vrbová enchants people from all over the world with her productions. Apart from agriculture, it was mainly the abundance of forests that ensured the livelihood of the inhabitants of the Bohemian Forest - including that of the carpenter Philipp von Manz, who processed local wood for his customers all over Germany. Veterinarian Judith Gollner, who grew up in the Austrian part of the Bohemian Forest, lived in Vienna for a long time and made a conscious decision to return. She likes the people and is proud of "her farmers' wives" who share her love of the Bohemian Forest. (S1 E02)

programme.title: mareTV: Madeira
programme.sub-title: Portugal's sea of blossoms in the Atlantic Ocean
programme.desc: Flower magic in Madeira: The Flower Festival Festa da Flor is the most important event of the year for the people of the Atlantic island. With it they celebrate spring, which is climatically practically all year round here, their island and themselves. The coast formed by lava, centuries-old laurel forests and green steep slopes make Madeira unique. Those who start right at the front of the big parade of the flower festival in the capital Funchal, will have made it. For Isabel Borges this dream has come true. She opens this year's flower parade along the harbour promenade with her festive group. This accolade does not only mean fame and prestige, but also a lot of pressure. Are the self-designed dresses splendid enough? Will the 150 flower children learn the dance steps in time? Will the flowers on the float hold out in the heat? For Isabel, it is now a matter of nerves.

programme.title: Dream Islands of Europe: Lanzarote and Fuerteventura
programme.desc: The film presents the two Canary Islands Lanzarote and Fuerteventura. Lanzarote has a rich culture in addition to a volcanic landscape: the film accompanies a ceramic artist, an instrument maker, shows architecture by César Manrique and a camel breeder. On Fuerteventura, in addition to livestock farming and the operation of traditional grain mills, nature conservation plays a major role: islanders are committed to preserving the sand dunes, and there is a turtle hatchery. On Lanzarote, countless volcanic eruptions have formed a bizarre lunar landscape. It is a great challenge for the inhabitants to extract the cultivation of food from the karstic, dry soil. And yet they even manage to produce wine. Protected by thousands of small depressions that act as water reservoirs, they grow vines on porous volcanic rock.

programme.title: Germany's Wild Reservoirs
programme.desc: One of the smallest dams in the Bergisches Land is the Panzertalsperre, with an area of just four-and-a-half football pitches. On the other hand, the Dhünntalsperre is the largest with the area of 660 football pitches. They all transform a stretch of flowing water into still and stagnant water. As a result, completely diverse ecosystems have developed there: where the dipper once dived for insect larvae, cormorants and gray herons now fish and swans and coots cavort. In recent summers, even greater challenges have emerged: the effects of climate change - from extreme drought to destructive floods. On a smaller scale, a rather industrious dam master is operating flood protection: The Beaver. However, the water masses of the Wupper tore away half of his majestic timber castle - and the four young beaver kids were not seen again afterwards. Have they survived the flood? Not everyone can cope with the constant change in the dams, but they still remain an important wonder of engineering for many: for us humans as well as for a number of animals. By combining water management, ecological requirements and tourism a worthwhile goal is possible: Because for the Bergisches Land, its dams are among the most valuable and popular infrastructures that the region has to offer.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.desc: Benny Rebel approaches a big cat in the semi desert with caution. An Asiatic cheetah is like an icon of Iranian nature. The carnivore accepts Benny in its closer environment. The photographer takes breath taking shots. Rewarded in this way Rebel continues his challenging expedition in a high mood. Deep in the desert he manages to come close to the last Wild Ass, so called Onager. The horse like animals are very shy and rare. From his hideouts Benny observes chinkaras, antelopes and impressive horned wild sheep in the mountains. Passing the snow topped Mount Damavand he reaches the green north part of Iran. Near the mystical forest of Persia the journey ends at the biggest inland lake of the world: the Caspian Sea. There Benny stalks on the pink flamingoes which gather there for feeding. The number and variety of species and landscapes of Iran is overwhelming but also endangered. On his photo and film expedition Benny Rebel documents the natural resources of Iran - also, to convince the government of his home country to protect their unique treasures of nature and culture.

programme.title: Rivers and Lakes
programme.desc: Water is the beginning of all life - including the wildlife of Germany. Beavers fell trees, otters play under water, kingfishers catch fish for their young. Lakes and rivers cover just 2.5% of the total area of the country. The episode Rivers and Lakes takes the viewer on a journey through the water world of Germany. In winter, the few ice-free surfaces are popular with waterfowl. Coots throng the source ponds of the River Havel, while above them white-tailed eagles gather for the hunt, as their prey swim openly beneath them. The coots stick together, swimming to and fro to make it difficult for the eagles to pick out one individual bird. But with each attack, the coots grow increasingly tired. In Spring, the ice melts and the lakes and rivers awake from their winter torpor. Germany has more than 800 rivers longer than 10km. They transport the life-giving liquid into all corners of the country. The water of the River Danube alone would be enough to fill Germany's biggest body of water, Lake Constance, in 12 months. Every year, six times the volume of the lake falls in the form of precipitation: 800 litres per square metre. Otters and beavers had a very hard time in recent centuries. They were hunted mercilessly for their fur and eaten in periods of fasting. Today, both species are protected and their populations are recovering.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Suzi and Gretchen get fused into a two-headed Gruzi! Then, Armand and the campers venture into the Petrifying Forest.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The campers must travel back in time to the old west to prevent Grandpappy Black Butt from stealing the deed to Lakebottom. Then, McGee gives Sawyer a high-tech chip that turns him into a Zomborg.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee becomes a human sweat hydrant after using zombie Sawye'rs anti-sweat cream! Then, McGee gets covered in delicious s'mores toppings, and is transformed into a s'mores monster! A S'Mogre!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Rosebud turns Camp Lakebottom into Camp LOCKDOWN-bottom! Then, Squirt develops a case of worms so bad, they try to EAT all of the Bottomdwellers!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Gretch's famous action-hero, movie-star parents visit Camp Lakebottom, and wind up getting a dramatic motivation they never dreamed of. Then, the kids discover an inter-dimensional portal.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Buttsquat and McGee get digitised into a classic 80's video game. Then, the Bottomdwellers travel through the interdimensional porta to an all-Sasquatch version of Camp Lakebottom.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The campers face the wrath of two mutated Ocean Apes, once the pets of McGee and Suzi, now seeking for revenge after being flushed years ago. Then, Squirt's ear wax gains its own consciousness!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Buttsquat uses all the evil tricks at his disposal to brainwash the kids into becoming an elite Butt-Squad of Buttsquat warriors! Then, an alien ship invades Camp Lakebottom.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Rosebud and the kids are drawn into a Squirrel-version of Lakebottom to answer for their crimes against all Squirrel-kind! Then, McGee's nightmare of being seen in only his undies becomes reality!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The kids must halt all partying at once, lest they summon the Party Animal to Lakebottom. Then, the kids befriend a lost circus elephant.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The kids enter a Lakebottom House of Horrors! Only to discover that they will soon be the house's star attractions!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The kids must find their way out of a Lakebottom dimension populated by giant Turkeysaurus Rexes. Then, McGee is desperate to get Santa Claus OUT of Lakebottom, after he crash-lands in camp!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee's toxic-rain induced cold causes his snot to attain future-telling powers! Then, the kids discover that Slimey is secretly hanging out with the Bottomlukers.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Middle-aged McGee travels from the future back to present-day Lakebottom to change the past. Then, the whole Lakebottom gang travels to McGee's town to find out what happened to his parents.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The kids prepare for the last week of camp by volunteering as staff-in-training to help with the unexpected arrival of two new campers. That is, until Buttsquat takes over the camp!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee, Gretchen and Squirt arrive at Camp Lakebottom to find themselves held captive by a zombie, a raging Sasquatch and a ruthless chef. Then, McGee and Buttsquat compete to see whose camp is best.

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: Peak Performance
programme.desc: The search for the Sandman leads Mateo and the others to the tallest mountain in the Dream World, but Lunia's hourglass puts a target on their backs.

programme.title: The Anomaly
programme.desc: A surprise visit from the Chief Inspector of the Night Bureau forces Mateo to hide Z-Blob, who goes on an adventure in the heart of Brooklyn.

programme.title: The Digiverse And Beyond, The Elemental Masters
programme.desc: Tackling a puzzle about technology in Ninjago. A riddle requires the Ninja to consider the powers and history of the Elemental Masters.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Getting Out the Vote
programme.desc: It's Stephanie vs. Tanya for Heartlake High Class President. But when Tanya resorts to dirty tricks, Stephanie decides to give her a taste of her own medicine. Elect Tanya as Heartlake High Class President?! "NOOOOOOOO!!!!" Not if Friends Stephanie, Emma, Olivia, Mia and Andrea can help it. The Friends are there to help their pal Matthew defeat Tanya -- even when Emma gets carried off by "Vote For Matthew" balloons! But Tanya figures since "Daddy" is now the Mayor of Heartlake City, she doesn't have to play by the rules. When she sneakily sabotages Matthew's campaign, it's time for a determined Stephanie to take his place as candidate. With the help of her friends, Stephanie is set on running a clean campaign -- that is, until Tanya resorts to more dirty tricks, and Stephanie decides to give Tanya a taste of her own medicine.

programme.title: Getting Tthe Message
programme.desc: text that accidentally sounds like a pledge of Emma's As the Friends enjoy Heartlake Amusement Park, Emma types a text to Mia, but sends it to Matthew by mistake a text that could be mega-embarrassing for Emma! As her BFF's, the Friends race to find Matthew's phone and erase the text before he reads it. But first, they must brave space rides, dunking booths and worse: the boys locker room! What's more frightening than a roller coaster? More innocent text to Mia was sent to Matthew by mistake -- a they need to brave space rides, dunking booths, an angry twisted than a funhouse mirror? A text gone wrong! The undying love for Matthew! Mega-embarrassing! As Emma's brute and worse - the boys locker room!Friends' fun day at Heartlake Amusement Park turns into a BFF's, the Friends must scramble to retrieve Matthew's frantic race against time when Emma discovers that her phone and erase the text before he reads it. programme.title: Transformers

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: With the Decepticons and Autobots allied, both armadas engage in battle in order to save Cybertron.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: The only way to defeat Unicron is to wake the minicons inside him and attack from within as well as without.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: The purpose and meaning behind the endless war is revealed.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Airachnid and Starscream struggle for control over an Insecticon warrior.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Optimus Prime seems to go on a destructive rampage, while MECH unveils their ultimate plan.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Agent Fowler has some explaining to do regarding recent events under the threat of military tribunal.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Bulkhead finds himself trapped on the Decepticon Warship, and caught amidst dual attempts on MegatronŌĆÖs life.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: A Dark Energon-infused Decepticon Warship becomes sentient and directly threatens humanity.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Team Prime splits off in a race to beat Megatron to the next four Iacon relics.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: The Decepticons install a powerful artifact from their ancient space vessel into Megatron.

programme.title: Don Smurfo
programme.desc: Everyone has their own dreams. That of Smurfette is to meet the legendary Don Smurfo, the dashing, witty, swashbuckling hero of many an engrossing tale. The Smurfs shrug at this infatuation. But when a real-life Don Smurfo appears in the village and Smurfette snubs them all in favor of the bragging stranger, they take the matter a little more seriously.

programme.title: Smurf On The Run
programme.desc: Little things can sometimes bring about big effects. In trying to catch Sassette, Gargamel upsets the Balance of Truth, and from then on everybody in the world tells lies. Even Papa Smurf is changed into a pathological liar. What is more, the Spirit of the Scales chain Gargamel and Sassette to each other, and together they have to replace the Topaz of Truth....

programme.title: Mud-Wrestling Smurfs
programme.desc: The Wartmongers are draining Smurf River to make mud for their wrestling matches. Clumsy, who has been feeling like a loser at sports, becomes a hero when he must wrestle the Mad Maher as a distraction, enabling Papa and Hefty to break into the factory and destroy the mud making machine.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Smurfs That Time Forgot: Being kind to animals brings unforeseen results for the Smurfs when they decide to bring a baby dinosaur back home... in its own era! This is the start of a series that spans space and time.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Swapping Smurfs: In trying to avoid doing his chores, Lazy Smurf finds an old abandoned well with an interesting peculiarity: anything that goes down in the bucket comes back up in its original brand-new condition. But is it good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Littlest Viking: The Smurfs take Grandpa Smurf to the King's castle so that he can meet Peewit. But what with one thing and another (especially another), the Smurfs and Peewit are taken aboard a Viking long ship. The Vikings take Peewit to be their mythical Great Warrior, the one who is going to vanquish the Storm King. Can the Smurfs help Peewit out of his quandary?

programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby's Marvelous Toy: It's been a few hundred years since Grandpa Smurf has seen this old toy… It was given to Papa Smurf long, long ago and he does not remember what it does. But Baby Smurf does know that it brings surprises for everyone!

programme.title: He Who Smurfs Last
programme.desc: Jokey's practical jokes go too far when Chlorhydris is the victim of one. She gets her revenge on the Smurfs by creating a spell to steal their sense of humor. Grouchy, who had no sense of humor to begin with, breaks the spell by getting back the humor potion.

programme.title: Jokey's Medecine
programme.desc: Because of Jokey's pranks, none of the Smurfs believe him when he tells them that Azrael the cat is ready to pounce on them. Feeling guilty and responsible, he hurries to Gargamel's castle and plays some explosive jokes on the wizard and his cat so he can free his friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Royal Drum: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Kow-Tow, We Won't Bow: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf On The Wild Side, Part I: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Snappy's Puppet: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - No Smurf Is An Island: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither

In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: The Frog Princess
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.desc: Masha and the Hare are having an epic game of hockey. When the game is at its peak, Masha goes off to find the missing puck and stumbles upon a broom. Now this is much better than a hockey stick and Masha gets an idea. But it turns out the broom can be used for things other than hockey.

programme.title: When Life Gives You Lemons

Treat the whole forest with lemonade - that's the best idea! Quiet date - that's not great! Hello lemonade fever!

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: Tee For Three
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Grim Testament About One Snotty Boy
programme.desc: Have you ever heard that the world around is full terrible plagues and diseases? One boy called Semushka knows it for sure! Wherever he threw a glance – he seemed to see tetanus, rubella and other kinds of chickenpoxes…The poor boy was so terrified that began to squish his nose even harder. The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

programme.title: A Myth Full Of Grief And Despair About One Historical Error
programme.desc: Here is a boy called Arkasha who really doesn't like history lessons. The most frightening thing for him was…a history test. He tried his best to prepare for the test, however he fell asleep. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!Do you know what children are scared the most of at school? What makes them tremble?!

programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Hamare
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: Paapnaashini Ganga
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Stories By Rabindranath Tagore

Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: The new Mercedes-Benz GLC AMG Line World Premiere Teaser
programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.title: The Mercedes EQS SUV Electric Art Line Driving Video
programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver's assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.
